name: LLM timeout check
blurb: How long one agent task can run before your SDK and loop settings stop it, when the model is silent, trickling or overloaded, and what to set when that is too long.

inputs.label: Stack
inputs.description: Fills the read timeout, retries and turns with that SDK's defaults. The Anthropic and OpenAI Python SDKs share theirs and have no turn limit, so they leave Turns as it is.

inputs.label: Read timeout
inputs.description: The SDK's timeout. It limits each wait for the next chunk, not the whole call.

inputs.label: Retries
inputs.description: How many times the SDK retries one call, waiting longer before each retry.

inputs.label: Attempt deadline
inputs.description: A limit on one whole attempt, set outside the SDK, such as asyncio.timeout. 0 for none.

inputs.label: Turns
inputs.description: Model calls in one task: your agent loop's limit.

inputs.label: max_tokens
inputs.description: The most output tokens one call may write. A trickling stream is assumed to send 2 tokens a second.

inputs.label: Acceptable wait
inputs.description: How long the task may take before it is too late: a person in a chat, or a job's own deadline. Every result is judged against it.

samples.label: Tuned for a chat: 3 s deadline, 1 retry, 4 turns
A batch job: an hour is fine
